## Checklist

- [ ] Every behavior change has a test in `test/<feature>.test.ts`.
- [ ] The docs that describe what changed are updated.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a user-facing line under the version being prepared.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, and code, comments and docs are in English.
